pqdwsx1j.baseName: Ark Mat Artificial Greenery Wreath Faux Fern for Front Doors - Evergreen Cascade
pqdwsx1j.variantName: Ark Mat Artificial Greenery Wreath Faux Fern for Front Doors - Evergreen Cascade
pqdwsx1j.sourceDescription: Bring a fresh botanical feel to your home with this beautiful Artificial Greenery Wreath, designed with realistic-looking faux fern leaves and lush foliage. Perfect for adding colour, texture and natural-inspired style to your front door, porch, wall or indoor space. This artificial fern wreath is a versatile decoration that can be enjoyed all year round. Unlike real foliage, it requires no watering, trimming or specialist care, making it an easy way to keep your home looking fresh and inviting. Simply display it on your front door, wall, window or anywhere that needs a decorative touch of greenery. Ideal for both everyday home decoration and special occasions, this faux greenery wreath can be used to create a welcoming entrance for guests or complement your existing décor. It is suitable for front doors, porches, hallways, living rooms, conservatories, garden rooms, weddings, parties and celebrations. The timeless fern design makes this wreath easy to style with a wide range of interiors and exterior décor. Use it on its own for a simple natural look or pair it with ribbons, flowers, lights and other decorations to create your own personalised display. A stylish and practical alternative to fresh foliage, this artificial fern wreath is a simple way to bring the beauty of greenery into your home without the ongoing maintenance of real plants. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD.

z6ht4zqn.baseName: Pegdev Traditional Christmas Tree Stand with 3 Legs for Trees up to 2.6m
z6ht4zqn.variantName: Pegdev Traditional Christmas Tree Stand with 3 Legs for Trees up to 2.6m
z6ht4zqn.sourceDescription: Keep your Christmas tree standing tall, secure and beautifully displayed with this traditional Christmas tree stand. Designed for real trees, it features a strong three-legged metal base for stability and three adjustable screw clamps to firmly hold your tree trunk in place. The built-in water tank ensures that your tree remains fresh and hydrated throughout the festive season, reducing needle drop and helping your tree look its best for longer. This practical and reliable design combines strength and convenience, offering quick and easy assembly with no tools required. Perfect for both family homes and festive displays, it can be reused year after year, maintaining its durability and charm. The timeless green finish complements any Christmas décor style, adding a classic touch to your festive setup. Available in two sizes to suit your needs — for trees up to 2.6 metres tall or up to 2.8 metres tall — this traditional stand ensures your tree remains upright and perfectly positioned for the entire holiday period. Simple, sturdy and designed to last, it’s the ideal base for your Christmas centrepiece. No specific safety warnings required when used as intended. Please use the product in accordance with its intended purpose. Pegdev Limited, Haywood Park Cotts (Main A513), Shugborough, Stafford, ST17 0XA
